messages:
Alex: FYI: tenant-isolation IAM cutover tonight 23:00 UTC. Serial TF apply per-tenant. Quiet window 23:00-02:00. Pin provider to v3.4.1. Canaries in staging at 22:00.
Maria G: Thanks. Which subnet/routing change could cause traffic disruption? Need to surface to CS.
Alex: Only IAM and org policy changes plus a tiny route53 alias update for isolation. No TGW changes. Tested in staging.
Jamal: @deploy-bot please schedule canary at 22:00 staging -> gate
deploy-bot: Schedule confirmed: canary staging 22:00 UTC. Auto-rollback threshold 5% errors or >150ms p50 increase. Will post status.
Kai: Do we have rollback playbook? If IAM bind fails, what's the escape hatch?
Alex: Yes — playbook pinned. Steps: 1) hold apply, 2) revert to previous tfstate snapshot, 3) run `terraform apply -target=module.iam -var=tenant=...` to revert binds, 4) open incident if >2 tenants impacted.
Maria G: :thumbsup: Add note to release notes: 'Tenant isolation IAM cutover — potential 401s for cross-tenant API calls briefly'.
deploy-bot: Canary started: 22:00 UTC staging. Plan output snippet:
```
module.iam.google_project_iam_binding.bind[0]: UPDATE in-place
+ member: user:service-account@x
```
Jamal: Staging canary looks clean. No 401s observed. Ready for prod canary at 23:00?
Alex: Yes. We'll do 2 tenant canaries in prod then stagger full rollout 10min per tenant. Monitor auth-errors, latency, deploy-bot signals.
Kai: I'll be on-call for first 30m. If errors >2% we abort and pin back.
deploy-bot: Prod canary started: 23:00 UTC tenant-a. If canary passes -> tenant-b 23:10 then rest 23:20.
Jamal: Can we hold on deployment if found that provider version 3.4.1 had a bug? Who owns provider pin?
Alex: I'll own provider pin/rollback. If provider causes issues we will unpin to latest-stable and restart canary. Keep tf state snapshot.
infra-rotation-bot: Reminder: Quiet window in effect 23:00-02:00 UTC. Pager suppression: on.
Maria G: Noted. I'll draft release note snippet and ping CS.
deploy-bot: Canary tenant-a: success. No errors. Moving to tenant-b.
Jamal: Tenant-b shows increased auth-errors 0.8% and 200ms p50 uptick. Suggest pause.
Alex: Pausing rollout. Reverting tenant-b changes. Running targeted revert now. `terraform apply -target=module.iam -var='tenant=b' -refresh=false`
deploy-bot: Revert applied for tenant-b. Canary rollback complete. Status: tenant-a ok, tenant-b reverted. Will not proceed to full rollout.
Kai: I'll open incident and collect logs. We should add extra asserts to evals to catch this.
Maria G: I'll update release notes: 'Rolling pause after tenant-b auth-regression; rollback performed; investigation ongoing.'
Alex: Thanks. Follow-up: schedule postmortem tomorrow 11:00. Re-enable quiet window for a limited retry.
